title: The Phantom Client
subtitle: A Chilling Mystery Amidst Hill Station Shadows
summary: When a renowned detective pens a letter shrouded in fear and uncertainty, the line between the rational and the supernatural begins to blur. Alone in a cold, shadowy hotel room, he faces a case that defies his love of truth—beckoning readers into a world where every flicker of candlelight could reveal a secret. Dare to follow Byomkesh Bakshi as he unravels the enigma of the phantom client.
